items.raw_excerpt: Tiene sillas con fundas blancas, una cruz y acoge cultos los martes y jueves. Dicho espacio estaba consagrado anteriormente a trabajadores de la Secom.
items.summary_en: Chile's government set up a permanent evangelical chapel inside La Moneda palace. The space has chairs with white covers and a cross. Worship services are held there every Tuesday and Thursday.

items.raw_excerpt: Some parts of Ekurhuleni are already experiencing heavy downpours and strong winds
items.summary_en: Heavy rain and strong winds are already hitting parts of Ekurhuleni. The city is asking residents to be careful and stay safe during the severe weather.

items.raw_excerpt: Summer is the slow season in Puerto Vallarta, but it's not supposed to be this slow. Writer Charlotte Smith examines the tourism situation.
items.summary_en: Summer is usually a slow season in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico. But this year the city is quieter than normal. A local writer looks at why so few tourists are coming.

items.summary_en: Chilean footballer Charles Aranguiz asked people to vote for a bill that would ban greyhound racing. He spoke out against the controversial activity.

items.summary_en: Air New Zealand's famous inflight lollies are made by a small family business. A revelation during a flight became reality. The story also asks how many lollies you can politely take.

items.raw_excerpt: Videos posted on social media have Brisbane residents heading out to get a glimpse of neon-blue bioluminescence. But what causes it, and is finding it more than blind luck?
items.summary_en: Neon-blue bioluminescence is drawing Brisbane residents to the water at night. Videos on social media helped spread the word about the glow. The light comes from tiny sea life, and spotting it takes some luck.
